entry.title: Petrof upright - lights cleaned, polished and re-wired.

link.title: Petrof upright - lights cleaned, polished and re-wired.

entry.content:
To get a bit more ambient and cosy light for the long winter evenings, I decided to fix the original lights. The brass was re-polished, the glass was washed and all cables exchanged!

I mean, look at the beauty!

entry.title: Malish accordion - new reeds waxed in!

link.title: Malish accordion - new reeds waxed in!

entry.content:
I finally waxed in new Tipo A-Mano reeds from Harmonikas. They have been sitting on my shelf for a while. I decided to only include one set of reeds even though I have the second tremolo reed set ready. If needed, I can always way in the second set, but the single, however, the single reed sounds sounds more pleasant to my ear.

The treble side is now ready to be played.

entry.title: Malish accordion - new reed block and bellow seals!

link.title: Malish accordion - new reed block and bellow seals!

entry.content:
Another progress on the Malish travel instrument. I managed to clean up the reed blocks front faces and attach new leather seals.

I also re-sealed the bellows with foam strips instead of the original leather.

entry.title: Petrof upright - hammers reshaped and hammer springs changed!

link.title: Petrof upright - hammers reshaped and hammer springs changed!

entry.content:
The first step in the new big project of mine was hammer reshaping. The original hammers had significant grooves. Lets see how they will play. I can always change them if needed later.

I also changed the hammer springs as the original ones were well aged and too weak.
entry.summary: The first step in the new big project of mine was hammer reshaping. The original hammers had significant grooves. Lets see how they will play. I can always change them if needed later.

entry.title: Malish accordion - pallet material change!
entry.content: Another exciting update for my travel instrument. The treble pallets are now stripped down from the original leather and replaced with a high-quality Hohner pallet material.

entry.title: Malish accordion - treble mechanics rebuild!
entry.content: The first step of the accordion reconstruction came in form of complete mechanics rebuilds. The mechanics was completely taken apart and a new contrasting red felt was installed under the buttons.
